Liga, 1st of 16 (champion) | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _uhlsportessential1gw | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = 008000 | body1 = 008000 | rightarm1 = 008000 | shorts1 = 008000 | socks1 = 008000 | pattern_la2 = _uhlsportstram19wb | pattern_b2 = _uhlsportstram19wb | pattern_ra2 = _uhlsportstram19wb | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = }} '''Sportclub Austria Lustenau''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in the town of [[Lustenau]], [[Vorarlberg]], Austria, that competes in the [[Austrian Football Bundesliga|Austrian Bundesliga]] , the first tier of the [[Austrian football league system]]. Founded in 1914, it is affiliated to the [[Vorarlberg Football Association]]. The team plays its home matches at [[Reichshofstadion]], where it has been based since 1951. The club's history includes several cup finals, numerous [[Promotion and relegation|promotions and relegations]], and some spells of sustained success. The club won the [[2021–22 Austrian Football Second League]] and returned to the [[Austrian Football Bundesliga]] for the [[2022–23 Austrian Football Bundesliga|2022–23 season]] for the first time in 22 years.{{cite news |title=Austria Lustenau bejubelt den Aufstieg in die Bundesliga |url=https://www.kicker.de/austria-lustenau-bejubelt-den-aufstieg-in-die-bundesliga-902110/artikel |access-date=19 June 2022 |work=kicker |date=13 May 2022 |language=de-DE}} [[File:Austria lustenau Performance Graph.png|260px|thumb|Historical chart of Austria Lustenau league performance]]"}}
